name: Golem Docs packages
source: docs/architecture.md, the package table and goals 2 and 6

modules.description: The document model (WordDocument) and the DOCX reader and writer
Operations, undo and redo, replica, the collaboration protocol
Scripts: API, stripper and linker, sandbox and runtime
The app: UI, WebGL renderer, format handlers, storage
The Worker: accounts, cloud documents, sharing, rooms, billing

rules: Dependencies point one way: libraries never import client or server.
The editor core has no dependency on the server (goal 2).
The format, layout, editing and PDF libraries have no third-party runtime dependencies, and the client ships none from npm. New dependencies need approval (goal 6).
